notes: No: for scalene T, direct copies force the edge labels around a vertex to shift by one step of the 3-cycle (a b c), so every vertex degree is divisible by 3 and its angle sum is (d/3)*pi; convexity forces degree 3, hence a tetrahedron with corners A, B, C at each vertex (disphenoid), which needs T acute. Lean: rec_closed, label_cycle_rec (3 | d), all_degree_three (V = 4), one_triple; axioms propext, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: the geometric steps (edge-to-edge facets, outward orientation gives one cyclic order of labels, convex vertex angle sum < 2*pi, disphenoid acute).
